rationale: The failure occurred because the homepage (/en-jp/) is not a PLP and contains no product tiles. A safe fix is to normalize root URLs to a known category PLP while preserving the locale segment, and to dismiss the cookie banner that can block interactions. This avoids unexpected modals/layouts and leverages existing selectors on an actual PLP.
code_hints: Before starting extraction, if current URL is the site root (with or without a locale segment), rewrite to `${root}/{locale-or-empty}men/ready-to-wear/jackets/` to land on a stable PLP.
After navigation, attempt to click the OneTrust cookie accept button `#onetrust-accept-btn-handler` if present; ignore errors if not found.
Wait for any of the PLP grid/tile selectors in overrides.wait_for_selectors; once present, perform a short progressive scroll to ensure tiles render before querying.
Reuse existing PLP/PDP selectors; no change required unless PLP still fails. If it does, log DOM and consider adding a specific tile selector observed at runtime.
